node.title: F2 weighted-kernel pointwise collision floor
node.statement: For every F_p-linear map A:F_p^m->V of rank d, the weighted ternary kernel mass Z(A) satisfies 2^m Z(A)=sum_v N(v)^2 exactly, where N(v) counts subset incidence vectors of syndrome v. It also equals p^{-d} sum_u product_s(1+cos(2 pi <u,a_s>/p)), equivalently (2^m/p^d) sum_u product_s cos^2(pi <u,a_s>/p). Consequently Z(A)>=max(1,2^m/p^d) pointwise. Each N(v) is a full-agreement list-recovery output size for ker(A) with coordinate lists of size two. No mass upper bound or max-fiber theorem is claimed.
